_readme: Single source of truth for site images. Every file lives in src/assets/images/<src> and MUST be .webp with a descriptive kebab-case name. Replace a placeholder by dropping a real .webp with the same file name (or run `npm run images -- <file> --to <src>`), then update its alt text here. Blog images are set in each post's frontmatter (heroImage + heroAlt).
